title: Beyond the 956: 2024 New Mexico Case Resurfaces as WorldStar Shares Interrogation-Room Escape Video
excerpt: A video shared by WorldStar on October 31 revisits a 2024 Tijeras, New Mexico case: Adlai Mestre, 24 at the time, allegedly kicked a hole through an interrogation-room wall and ran down a hallway before deputies quickly recaptured him. content:
🌎 BEYOND THE 956

TIJERAS, N.M. — A video shared by WorldStar on October 31 revisits a 2024 New Mexico case, showing a man in custody allegedly kicking a hole through an interrogation-room wall, crawling through the opening and running down a hallway before deputies quickly recaptured him.

The man in the video is Adlai Mestre, who was 24 at the time. The Bernalillo County Sheriff's Office said deputies responded on October 13, 2024, to a report of gunshots at a home in Tijeras, New Mexico, and later detained Mestre at the home.

Mestre faces charges in connection with the alleged killings of his parents and his teenage sister, including three counts of first-degree murder, along with counts of tampering with evidence, extreme cruelty to animals, escape from the custody of a peace officer and criminal damage to property, according to the Sheriff's Office and news reports on the case.

The escape attempt shown in the video took place during questioning at a sheriff's substation, according to the reports. Deputies apprehended Mestre in the hallway shortly after he broke through the wall, the reports said.

The charges are allegations, and Mestre is presumed innocent until proven guilty. The victims are not named here, including the teenage victim.

Sources: WorldStar (@worldstar) Instagram post, October 31; Bernalillo County Sheriff's Office, via City Desk and ABQ RAW reports on the October 2024 case.
